column2: 33. (1) Any expense incurred by the Commission in any
suit or prosecution brought by or against the Commission
before  any  court  shall  be  paid  out  of  the  Fund  of  the
Commission,  and  any  costs  paid  to,  or  recovered  by,  the
Commission in any such suit or prosecution shall be credited
to the Fund of the Commission.
(2) Any expenses incurred by any person in any suit or
prosecution brought against him before any court in respect
of any act which is done by him under this Act, or on the
direction  of  the  Commission  shall,  if  the  court  holds  that
such act was done in good faith, be paid out of the Fund the
